death.note: He passed away in Mecca in Ramadan of 882 H. "Wa-laʿallahu Ibn Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar yaʾtī": he is perhaps identical with the later Ḥasan b. Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar — that later notice survives in the corpus only as a cross-reference stub ("uḥīla ʿalayhi fī al-Ḥasan b. Jaʿfar fa-yunẓar") pointing back to this entry.

person.note: ハサン・ブン・ジャアファル。882年のラマダーンにマッカで死去。恐らく、後述する（ハサン・ブン・）ムハンマド・ブン・ジャアファルと同一人物であろう。
Ḥasan b. Jaʿfar. He died in Mecca in Ramadan of the year 882 H. He is perhaps identical with the (Ḥasan b.) Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar who is to come.
